Use the smcd seid command to control the system enterprise ID (EID). You can disable the system EID while at least one user defined EID entry exists. A disabled system EID is automatically enabled when the last user defined EID entry is deleted.

smcd seid show

show the system EID

smcd seid enable

enable the system EID

smcd seid disable

disable the system EID

1. Disable the system EID
# smcd seid disable
